problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to load onto a delivery truck. The available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 44 kg, revenue 168 dollars
* Container 2: weight 37 kg, revenue 242 dollars
* Container 3: weight 27 kg, revenue 102 dollars
* Container 4: weight 2 kg, revenue 242 dollars
* Container 5: weight 17 kg, revenue 107 dollars
* Container 6: weight 25 kg, revenue 42 dollars
* Container 7: weight 23 kg, revenue 59 dollars
* Container 8: weight 8 kg, revenue 23 dollars
* Container 9: weight 23 kg, revenue 20 dollars
* Container 10: weight 12 kg, revenue 216 dollars
* Container 11: weight 40 kg, revenue 16 dollars
* Container 12: weight 21 kg, revenue 243 dollars
* Container 13: weight 36 kg, revenue 263 dollars

The truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 220 kg. Determine which containers to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
